grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在进行的动作，常与when/while等连词搭配使用

examples.en: The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport.
examples.zh: 飞机晚点了，侦探们正在机场等候。

examples.en: While two detectives were keeping guard, two others opened the parcel.
examples.zh: 当两名侦探在门口看守时，另外两人打开了包裹。

grammar.title: 过去进行时与一般过去时的对比 (Past Continuous vs Past Simple)
grammar.structure: 过去进行时: was/were + doing / 一般过去时: did
grammar.definition: 过去进行时表示正在进行的动作，一般过去时表示已完成的动作 当两个过去动作同时发生时，用while连接进行时态的动作；表示短暂动作或主句动作用一般过去时

examples.en: When the plane arrived, some detectives were waiting inside.
examples.zh: 当飞机到达时，一些侦探正在里面等候。

examples.en: Two men took the parcel off the plane.
examples.zh: 两个人把包裹从飞机上拿下来。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作 用于描述过去的过去发生的事情，常与a few hours earlier等时间状语连用

examples.en: A few hours earlier, someone had told the police.
examples.zh: 几个小时前，有人已经告诉过警察了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + 时间/地点

original.en: Detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
original.zh: 侦探们整个上午都在机场等待。

imitations.zh: 她昨天一直在办公室工作。

patterns.pattern: When + 一般过去时 + 主句(过去进行时)

original.en: When the plane arrived, some detectives were waiting inside.

patterns.pattern: While + 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + 主语 + 动词-ed

lines.en: The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
lines.zh: 飞机误点了，侦探们在机场等了整整一上午。

lines.en: They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa.
lines.zh: 他们正期待从南非来的一个装着钻石的贵重包裹。

lines.en: A few hours earlier, someone had told the police that thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
lines.zh: 数小时以前，有人向警方报告，说有人企图偷走这些钻石。

lines.en: When the plane arrived, some of the detectives were waiting inside the main building while others were waiting on the airfield .
lines.zh: 当飞机到达时，一些侦探等候在主楼内，另一些侦探则守候在停机坪上。

lines.zh: 有两个人把包裹拿下飞机，进了海关。

lines.en: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door, two others opened the parcel.
lines.zh: 这时两个侦探把住门口，另外两个侦探打开了包裹。

lines.zh: 令他们吃惊的是，那珍贵的包裹里面装的全是石头和沙子！

translation:
飞机误点了，侦探们在机场等了整整一上午。
他们正期待从南非来的一个装着钻石的贵重包裹。
数小时以前，有人向警方报告，说有人企图偷走这些钻石。
当飞机到达时，一些侦探等候在主楼内，另一些侦探则守候在停机坪上。
有两个人把包裹拿下飞机，进了海关。
这时两个侦探把住门口，另外两个侦探打开了包裹。
令他们吃惊的是，那珍贵的包裹里面装的全是石头和沙子！
title: Too late
subtitle: 为时太晚

lead.question: 警察在机场守候整整一上午，为什么打开贵重包裹后看到的却是石头和沙子？
lead.warmup: 飞机晚点，侦探们却在机场守了一上午——他们等的不是旅客，而是一个从南非运来的钻石包裹。数小时前警方已接到密报：有人要偷这批钻石。于是飞机一降落，有人守主楼，有人守停机坪，分工严密。可包裹打开时，里面全是石头和沙子。读这篇课文前，请先想一想：钻石究竟在哪一步被掉包的？
goals: 掌握过去进行时的构成，分清它与一般过去时的分工
区分 when 与 while：when 可引出短暂动作，while 多连接同时进行的动作
掌握核心搭配 keep guard、to one's surprise、be full of、take sth. off
辨析 expect 与 wait (for)，并记牢 steal—stole—stolen 等不规则变化
lead.summary: 课文按时间顺序推进：先交代侦探在机场等候南非钻石包裹，再补叙数小时前的案情通报，接着铺开主楼与停机坪两处布控，最后以开箱只见石头沙子收尾。语法核心是过去进行时：when 引出短暂动作，while 连接同时进行的动作。重点搭配有 keep guard、to one's surprise、be full of。
lead.tips: expect 是及物动词，后接名词或用 expect sb. to do sth.，切勿写成 expect for；含 wait 才搭配 for（wait for sb.）。

questions.q: What did the detectives find in the parcel when they opened it?
questions.zh: 侦探们打开包裹后，在里面发现了什么？
questions.a: To their surprise, they found that the precious parcel was full of stones and sand, not diamonds.
questions.aZh: 令他们吃惊的是，那珍贵的包裹里装的全是石头和沙子，而不是钻石。
questions.hint: 答案见全文最后一句：To their surprise, the precious parcel was full of stones and sand!

questions.q: Why were the detectives waiting at the airport all morning?
questions.zh: 侦探们为什么在机场等了整整一上午？
questions.a: Because they were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa.
questions.aZh: 因为他们正等待一个从南非运来的贵重钻石包裹。
questions.hint: 见第 2 句：They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa。

questions.q: What had someone told the police a few hours earlier?
questions.zh: 数小时以前，有人向警方报告了什么？
questions.a: He had told the police that thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
questions.aZh: 他向警方报告说，有贼企图偷走这些钻石。
questions.hint: 见第 3 句：someone had told the police that thieves would try to steal the diamonds。

questions.q: What were two detectives doing while two others opened the parcel?
questions.zh: 另外两名侦探打开包裹时，那两名侦探在做什么？
questions.a: They were keeping guard at the door.
questions.aZh: 他们正在门口把风（守卫）。
questions.hint: 见倒数第 2 句：While two detectives were keeping guard at the door, two others opened the parcel。

questions.q: Why do you think the parcel was full of stones and sand instead of diamonds?
questions.zh: 你觉得为什么包裹里装的是石头和沙子而不是钻石？
questions.a: Because the diamonds had probably been taken out and the parcel filled with stones and sand before the plane landed; the thieves had already stolen the diamonds, so the detectives were too late.
questions.aZh: 很可能在飞机降落之前，钻石就被取出，包里换成了石头和沙子；真钻石早已被盗，所以侦探们为时已晚。
questions.hint: 结合倒数第 3、4 句推断：包裹由两名男子从飞机上取下，说明上机前或途中已被掉包。

exercises.q: 汉译英：飞机误点了，侦探们在机场等了整整一上午。
exercises.a: The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
exercises.note: 持续动作用过去进行时，all morning 表整段。

exercises.q: 汉译英：令他们吃惊的是，那珍贵的包裹里面装的全是石头和沙子！
exercises.a: To their surprise, the precious parcel was full of stones and sand!
exercises.note: to one's surprise 与 be full of 连用。

exercises.q: 根据汉语提示填空：They were expecting a ______ (贵重的) parcel of ______ (钻石) from South Africa.
exercises.note: valuable 可换 precious，diamond 用复数。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 while 合并两句。Two detectives were keeping guard at the door. Two others opened the parcel.
exercises.a: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door, two others opened the parcel.
exercises.note: while 连接同时进行的过去动作。

exercises.q: 用 expect 或 wait (for) 的适当形式填空：The detectives ______ a valuable parcel from South Africa, while the thieves ______ a chance to steal the diamonds.
exercises.note: expect 表预料，wait for 指等待动作。

exercises.q: 用括号中动词的适当形式填空：Nobody knew that the diamonds had already ______ (steal).
改错（一处）：The valuable parcel was worth to guard day and night.
exercises.a: The valuable parcel was worth guarding day and night.
exercises.note: worth 后接动名词，主动表被动。

quiz.q: “侦探们在机场等了整整一上午”的正确英文表达是：
options: The detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
The detectives were waiting on the airport all morning.
The detectives waited at the airport all morning.
The detectives have waited at the airport all morning.
quiz.note: at the airport 为固定搭配，此处用过去进行时。

quiz.q: “当飞机到达时，一些侦探正等候在主楼内”的正确译文是：
options: Some detectives were waiting inside the main building when the plane arrived.
Some detectives waited inside the main building while the plane arrived.
Some detectives are waiting inside the main building when the plane arrived.
Some detectives were waiting inside the main building while the plane was arriving.
quiz.note: 背景动作用过去进行时，短暂动作用 when 引出。

quiz.q: “两名侦探把住门口”的正确表达是：
options: Two detectives were keeping guard at the door.
Two detectives were keeping guard to the door.
Two detectives were making guard at the door.
Two detectives were keeping a guard of the door.
quiz.note: keep guard 意为“守望、警戒”，门口用 at。

options: To their surprise
For their surprise
In their surprise
With their surprise
quiz.note: to one's surprise 为固定短语。

quiz.q: “那珍贵的包裹里装满了石头和沙子”的正确英文是：
options: The precious parcel was full of stones and sand.
The precious parcel was full with stones and sand.
The precious parcel was filled of stones and sand.
The precious parcel fulled of stones and sand.
quiz.note: be full of 表状态，be filled with 才是另一搭配。

quiz.q: “他们正期待一个来自南非的贵重包裹”的正确英文是：
options: They were expecting a valuable parcel from South Africa.
They were expecting for a valuable parcel from South Africa.
They were waiting a valuable parcel from South Africa.
They were waiting for a parcel valuable of diamonds.
quiz.note: expect 是及物动词，不加 for；wait 后须加 for。
